tutorial.title: How do I get these values?
tutorial.intro: You'll need admin access to a Meta Business Manager that contains the ad account, Facebook page, and (optionally) Instagram account you want to use.
tutorial.tokenDesc: Recommended: create a System User in Business Settings → System Users, assign it to your Ad Account and Page, and generate a token with ads_management, ads_read, business_management, pages_manage_ads, pages_read_engagement and instagram_basic permissions. System User tokens last 60 days.
tutorial.tokenDescAlt: Quick test only: you can also generate a short-lived user token from the Graph API Explorer, but it expires in 1–2 hours.
tutorial.adAccountDesc: Open Meta Ads Manager. Your ad account ID appears in the URL as ?act=123456789 and in the account dropdown at the top-left. Paste it here prefixed with act_ (for example act_123456789).
tutorial.pageDesc: Easiest path: Business Settings → Pages → select your page → the numeric ID is shown under the page name. You can also find it on the page itself under About → Page transparency.
tutorial.igDesc: Only required if you plan to publish to Instagram. Business Settings → Accounts → Instagram accounts → select your account → copy the numeric ID below the username. Your Instagram must be a Business or Creator account linked to the same Business Manager as the page above.
tutorial.warning: Keep the access token private. If it leaks, revoke it from Business Settings and generate a new one.
